messages:
mariam: Quick note 1: all-hands next Tue 9:00am PT. Theme: "Launch synthesis + compliance check". 40m total: 12m exec recap, 10m launch metrics + cost wins, 8m privacy/compliance update, 5m customer shoutouts, 5m open Q&A. Please send any must-cover bullets by EOD Fri.

lucas: Invite posted: <https://calendar.redwood.com/event/3250012345>. Please RSVP so we can gauge room/catering for the hybrid audience.

priya: For the cost segment I'll show per-token spend vs baseline and the batching/quantization knobs we flipped. Will need 2 slides + one short chart screenshot. Upload to the shared deck: <https://drive.redwood.com/allhands/summer-synthesis>.

carla: Compliance update: we'll announce the new "ephemeral logs by default" setting for hosted projects (90-day archive only via opt-in). Draft FAQ is in the drive; please review and comment by Thu. Link: <https://drive.redwood.com/policies/ephemeral-logs-draft>.

jon_ops: Ops will present a 90s summary of last week's degraded routing event and show the new circuit-breaker rule we deployed. I'll post the 1-pager here Mon morning. Also confirming the recording + captions; allhands-recorder will publish the transcript after the meeting.

mariam: Accessibility: captions on, transcript attached after. If you need ASL or live interpretation reply here with "interpretation: yes".

priya: LIVE  question: will the ephemeral logs default impact Dedicated customers?

carla: LIVE answer: Dedicated customers keep existing retention controls by contract; were adding a migration path for Hosted customers who want longer retention. We'll show the opt-in flow in the FAQ slide.

lucas: Tiny logistics: presenters upload slides Mon EOD; keep demos under 90s. If you need present privileges DM me.

allhands-recorder: Reminder scheduled: 24h and 1h before start. Recording will begin automatically and transcript will be posted to #all-hands-resources and the shared deck. :sparkles:

mariam: Action list: 1) Priya upload cost slides (Mon EOD). 2) Carla finalize policy FAQ (Thu EOD). 3) Jon post the incident 1-pager Mon AM. 4) Everyone: drop Qs in-thread or use the intake form <https://forms.redwood.com/allhands-qa>. I'll post final speaker order Mon AM. Thanks! :tada:
